decisions.statement: A migration names the one addon that migration runs for.
A rename writes the new file and leaves the old file alone.
A rename whose new file is already there is skipped.
A rename matching no global writes nothing.
An append copies the target aside before writing the target.
An append whose target is absent is skipped rather than made.
Nothing here runs a whole list of migrations.
Nothing here says what a migration did.

definition: a player's saved variables carried to the file the folded-together addon reads
